sites.name: Display name
sites.baseUrlDefaultHint: The first item is the current / default route

sites.routeSwitchPartial: Route switched; some targets failed to update
sites.routeSwitchSkipped: Route switched without updating applied tools
sites.apiKeyKeepHint: The complete key is loaded; use the eye to reveal it or overwrite it to replace

sites.quotaError: Could not refresh quota; try again

sites.modelListFetchFailed: Could not fetch the model list

sites.noModels: No models yet — fetch or add manually
sites.testNoKey: This site has no API key
sites.clearModelsConfirm: Clear all models in this list?

sites.deleteSelectedModelsHint: Only removes them from the local list. You can fetch from upstream again.
sites.cleanupTargets: Also clean managed config from target CLIs

sites.urlPreviewEmpty: Enter a valid Base URL to preview write targets
sites.disableAppliedHint: This site is applied to {{targets}}. Clear those app configs as well?
sites.disableClearedSuccess: Site disabled and related app configs cleared

sites.deepLinkNeedKey: This link has no API key — finish it in the form

apply.title: Apply Center
apply.defaultModelHint: Writes ANTHROPIC_MODEL as Claude Code’s default model
apply.codexModelHint: Writes the model field in config.toml
apply.restoreOfficialClaudeHint: Removes ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, and relay model overrides from settings.json so Claude Code uses the official claude.ai login. Official credentials are kept. Current files are backed up first.
apply.restoreOfficialCodexHint: Removes the relay provider, openai_base_url, and the catalog this app wrote from config.toml, and clears injected XIAOBAI_* environment variables so Codex uses the official ChatGPT login. auth.json is kept. Current files are backed up first.
apply.restoreOfficialClaudeOk: Cleared the Claude Code relay config. You can sign in with the official account.
apply.restoreOfficialCodexOk: Cleared the Codex relay config. You can sign in with the official ChatGPT account.
apply.revertConfirmHint: Removes config written by this app. The CLI will show as not applied.
apply.cleanupConfirmHint: Deletes leftover writes that no longer match a site.
apply.openPathFailed: Could not open the config path
apply.dualWarning: The same model id may not work across Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and Prime. You can still force apply.
apply.resultPiOk: Wrote Pi models.json, auth.json, and settings.json.
apply.resultPrimeOk: Wrote Prime models.json, auth.json, and settings.json.
apply.failedHint: Could not write the target config. Check status and try again.
apply.restartHint: Restart your terminal or CLI tool for changes to take effect.
apply.noSite: Add and select a site first
apply.noEnabledSite: No enabled sites — enable one in Sites first
apply.modelMapHint: Map Claude Code’s built-in opus / sonnet / haiku aliases to model ids on the selected site
apply.context1mHint: Append the [1m] declaration to the default model and Opus / Sonnet aliases. The model and gateway must actually support 1M context
apply.writeAllModels: Write all site models into Codex
apply.writeAllModelsHint: Generates a model catalog so you can switch models inside Codex
apply.catalogModelCount: {{count}} models will be written to the catalog
apply.piWriteAllModels: Write all site models into Pi
apply.piWriteAllModelsHint: When off, only the default model is written. Turn it on to switch with Pi’s /model command.
apply.removePiConfirm: Remove the XiaoBai config from Pi?
apply.removePiHint: Only the managed provider and its API key are removed. Other custom providers, OAuth logins, and unknown settings are preserved. Current files are backed up first.
apply.removePiDone: Removed the managed Pi provider and restored the pre-apply defaults when it was safe to do so.
apply.primeWriteAllModels: Write all site models into Prime
apply.primeWriteAllModelsHint: When off, only the default model is written. Turn it on to switch with Prime’s /model command.
apply.removePrimeConfirm: Remove the XiaoBai config from Prime?
apply.removePrimeHint: Only the managed provider and its API key are removed. Other custom providers, OAuth logins, and unknown settings are preserved. Current files are backed up first. The plaintext key is written to ~/.prime/agent/auth.json.
apply.removePrimeDone: Removed the managed Prime provider and restored the pre-apply defaults when it was safe to do so.
apply.reasoningHint: Written to Codex config.toml; only affects models that support reasoning
apply.remoteCompactionHint: Send long-session compaction to the current site. Most relays do not support this — leave it off. When on, the provider display name is written as OpenAI (the condition Codex uses to allow remote compaction); when off, the site name is restored.
apply.imageUnderstandingHint: Allow Codex to send local images to the model. Turn this off for text-only relays. If you also write the model catalog, entries will declare text + image.
apply.imageGenerationHint: Allow Codex to use the built-in image generation tool. Most relays do not support it — leave it off. Independent of image understanding.
apply.webSearchHint: Allow Codex to use the built-in web_search tool. Turn this off if the site rejects that tool, or requests will fail.
apply.capabilityFollowHint: Use the Codex-specific capability switches saved on the site. Editing the site updates the next apply.
apply.capabilityCustomHint: Override the site presets for this apply only. This is not written back to the site.
apply.noBackupsHint: Applying config backs up the current files. Retention is configured in Settings.
apply.restoreBackupConfirmHint: This overwrites the current config files with the backup. The current files will be replaced and cannot be undone.
apply.deleteBackupConfirmHint: This cannot be undone. Only continue if you no longer need this backup.
apply.restoreBackupSuccess: Backup restored. Current config was overwritten.
apply.backupPreviewFailed: Could not read the backup summary

settings.title: Settings
settings.proxySystemHint: Uses the OS proxy. PAC files are not evaluated; if only a PAC is configured, HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY env vars are used as fallback.
settings.probeTtlHint: Opening the route dropdown re-probes URLs older than this. Default is 10 minutes.
settings.autoStartFailed: Could not register launch at login. Check system permissions and try again.
settings.closeToTrayHint: Closing the window keeps the app running in the menu bar / tray. Choose Quit from the tray to exit.
settings.startInTrayHint: Only available when minimize-to-tray is on. Useful with launch at login.
settings.startInTrayDisabled: Turn on “Minimize to tray on close” first
settings.pathPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the target's default config directory
settings.forceExclusiveAuthHint: When on, deletes the other auth field (API_KEY / AUTH_TOKEN)
settings.maxBackupCopiesHint: Default is 30; oldest copies of each type are removed when the limit is exceeded

backupCenter.loadFailed: Could not load local backup information
backupCenter.localDeleteConfirmBody: This permanently deletes “{{name}}” and cannot be undone

settings.checkUpdateDesktopOnly: Check for updates in the desktop app
settings.noUpdate: You are on the latest version
settings.checkUpdateFailed: Failed to check for updates, please try again later
settings.securityBody: API keys are encrypted in-app. After apply they are written in plaintext to Claude settings.json, codex.env, ~/.pi/agent/auth.json, or ~/.prime/agent/auth.json. Do not sync ~/.xiaobai-switch, ~/.claude, ~/.codex, ~/.pi, or ~/.prime to untrusted cloud storage.
settings.plaintextPaths: Paths that may contain plaintext secrets

webdav.title: WebDAV application backup
webdav.securityWarningTitle: Remote archives include the master key needed to decrypt credentials
webdav.securityWarningBody: The ZIP contains the application database and master.key, with no extra backup password; anyone who obtains it may decrypt stored API keys, so use only a trusted WebDAV service and account
webdav.passwordSavedHint: The password is stored encrypted; leave this blank to keep it unchanged
webdav.invalidCertWarning: This skips server certificate checks and may expose the WebDAV password and backup contents; enable it only when you fully trust the network and server
webdav.loadFailed: Could not load WebDAV backup information
webdav.backupFailed: Could not create the application backup
webdav.cleanupWarning: The backup was uploaded, but old remote backups could not be pruned; check them later
webdav.restoreConfirmBody: A safety snapshot of current application data will be created first, then “{{name}}” will be verified and restored; the app will restart, and Claude/Codex configuration will not be overwritten automatically
webdav.restoreApplied: Application data restored; review target status and reapply configurations manually if needed
webdav.restoreFailed: Application data could not be restored; existing data was preserved, see the application log for details
webdav.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently deletes “{{name}}” and cannot be undone
webdav.quickSecurityWarning: Backups include the database and decryption master key; store them only in trusted locations

onboarding.welcomeDesc: Three steps to configure an AI upstream site for Claude Code, Codex, or Pi.
